details.biography:
Alexandre Millet is a French visual effects supervisor at Digital Domain, with a career in the feature film industry spanning over 17 years. He has held various senior roles at Digital Domain for more than a decade, including DFX Supervisor, Look Development Department Supervisor, Sequence Supervisor, and CG Supervisor, which has given him a deep and broad understanding of the full visual effects pipeline.

Among his more recent projects, Millet served as Visual Effects Supervisor on The Conjuring: Last Rites (2025) and was Associate VFX Supervisor on The Electric State (2025). He was nominated in 2022 for the Hollywood Professional Association Award for Outstanding Visual Effects ‒ Theatrical Feature for his work on Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022). In earlier periods of his career, he contributed to films such as Pixels (2015), Morbius (2022), X-Men: Days of Future Past (2014), Ender’s Game (2013), Captain America: The First Avenger (2011), Shazam! (2019), The Dark Knight Rises (2012), Inception (2010), and Iron Man 2 (2010).
details.name: Alexandre Millet
